The four positional amounts in INR thousand. <type> is accounts, budget_estimate or revised_estimate; <year> is the fiscal year with an underscore. Position 1 = Actuals of year minus 2, 2 = BE of year minus 1, 3 = RE of year minus 1, 4 = BE of the document year. Plan era: the printed Total sub-column. Blank when the cell is blank or holds text (a label, a bracketed code such as (00), a code with a trailing comma such as 904,; flag NON_MONEY_AMOUNT). 0 when the book prints a nil mark (.., - or .). -,15 reads as -15. Rule and counts: MH_README.md, Money cells.
